name: Sven Simon - Proposition de décision
title: REPORT on amendments to Parliament’s Rules of Procedure concerning the declaration of input (Article 8 of Annex I to the Rules of Procedure)
part_text:
Parliament is changing its own internal rules. When a member writes a report for Parliament, they must list who gave them information on the topic. Under the new rule, that list must name two kinds of people: lobbyists covered by the European Union's transparency register, and representatives of foreign public authorities, including embassies. The list goes in an annex to the report. The rule only covers input that the member actually used in the report.

- What changes: the list of people who gave input must name lobbyists and foreign officials, not just anyone.
- Who it affects: members of Parliament who write reports, and the lobbyists and foreign representatives they consult.
- What happens next: the new rule takes effect on the first day of the next part-session.
